description: Report which products of one marketplace channel were reached by the last syncs and which were not, and why — from stored state, without calling the marketplace. Per product on the channel: state (attention = the marketplace reported a problem with the listing; never_sent = nothing recorded as sent, or no listing is linked; changed_since_sent = the product changed after it was last sent; paused = syncing paused for it; sent = sent and unchanged), a plain-language reason, lastSyncedAt (when the CRM last sent it), observedAt (when the marketplace last answered about it — null means never asked), presence, listing id, moderationStage/Action and up to 3 issues, productUpdatedAt. Also returns counts per state over the whole channel, the adapters' own last run (lastRun: matched, updated, failed, unmatched, error, lastSuccessAt and, for Google Merchant, failedSample — up to 5 refused products with Google's own message), pagination, and notStored — what the CRM does NOT keep, chiefly a reason for EVERY refused product (only the last run's sample is stored), so do not invent one. For attention, presence not_available counts only when the marketplace itself answered (observedAt set) and the channel sells; on an advertising channel (Google Merchant) it never does. Worst first; filter with state; page with page and perPage. Read-only. Use list_channel_products for price and stock on the channel and check_channel_readiness for why a product would be refused before it is sent.

platform.description: The marketplace slug returned by list_marketplaces (prom, rozetka, woocommerce, shopify, olx, amazon, ebay, google_merchant, vinted, etsy).

state.description: Only products in this state: attention (the marketplace reported a problem with the listing), never_sent (nothing was ever sent, or no listing is linked), changed_since_sent (the product changed after it was last sent), paused (syncing paused for this product), sent (sent and unchanged since). Omit for every product, worst first.
